Q1: Which part of the coding-workflows pipeline should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) Clarify phase (`ai-clarify.yml` and its prompts)
B) Plan or Implement phases
C) Review and autofix (`review_autofix.yml` and its helper scripts)
D) Orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_*`)
E) Docs only (README, `docs/`, agents.d fragments)
F) Something else: I will name the file, workflow or component in my `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. I will link the run, issue or log line (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or runtime: fewer tokens, runner jobs or API calls
C) Make it more reliable: fewer stalls, retries or manual steps
D) Make the docs or messages clearer
E) Add a new capability. I will describe the behaviour I want
Q3: How will we know the issue is done?
Choices:
A) I will give a concrete before/after behaviour or a measurable target in my `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B) A named failing run or test passes after the change
C) Close this issue and open a new, specific one instead
